import java.util.*;

public class Text_Document_Analysis {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        br.readLine();
        String input = br.readLine();
        
        int maxWordLength = 0;
        String[] parts = input.split("\\([a-zA-Z_]*\\)");
        for (String part : parts) {
            String[] words = part.split("_+");
            for (String word : words) {
                if (word.length() > maxWordLength) {
                    maxWordLength = word.length();
                }
            }
        }
        
        int identifierCount = 0;
        boolean inParentheses = false;
        boolean lastWasLetterInParens = false;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); i++) {
            char c = input.charAt(i);
            if (c == '(') {
                inParentheses = true;
                lastWasLetterInParens = false;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                inParentheses = false;
                lastWasLetterInParens = false;
            } else if (inParentheses && Character.isLetter(c)) {
                if (!lastWasLetterInParens) {
                    identifierCount++;
                    lastWasLetterInParens = true;
                }
            } else if (c == '_') {
                lastWasLetterInParens = false;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxWordLength + " " + identifierCount);
    }

        String line = br.readLine();
        
        int maxLen = 0;
        String[] segments = line.split("\\([a-zA-Z_]*\\)");
        for (String seg : segments) {
            String[] tokens = seg.split("_+");
            for (String token : tokens) {
                maxLen = Math.max(maxLen, token.length());
            }
        }
        
        int count = 0;
        Matcher m = Pattern.compile("\\([a-zA-Z]+\\)").matcher(line);
        while (m.find()) {
            String id = line.substring(m.start() + 1, m.end() - 1);
            int len = id.length();
            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                if (i == 0 || !Character.isLetter(id.charAt(i - 1))) {
                    if (Character.isLetter(id.charAt(i))) {
                        count++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxLen + " " + count);
    }
